nodes.type_context:
Mathlib
def powerful (n : Nat) : Bool := ∀ p ∈ (Finset.range (n + 1)).filter Nat.Prime, n % (p * p) = 0

def blockProduct (n k : Nat) : Nat := ∏ x ∈ Finset.Ioc n (n + k), x

def noPowerfulBlockUpTo (k bound : Nat) : Bool := ∀ n ∈ Finset.range (bound + 1), !(powerful (blockProduct n k))
nodes.claim: This fragment checks, by total exact computation, that for every n ≤ 15 the product of the three integers in Finset.Ioc n (n + 3) is not powerful, and for every n ≤ 6 the product of the four integers in Finset.Ioc n (n + 4) is not powerful.
